+@pytest.mark.parametrize('source, task_vars, expected', [
+    (b'#!/usr/bin/python3.8 -I\n', {}, '#!/usr/bin/python3.8 -I'),
+    (b'#!/opt/venv/bin/python -B\n', {}, '#!/opt/venv/bin/python -B'),
+    (b'#!/usr/bin/python3.8 -I\n', {'ansible_python_interpreter': '/opt/venv/bin/python'},
+     '#!/opt/venv/bin/python -I'),
+    (b'', {}, '#!/usr/bin/python'),
+])
+def test_new_python_module_shebang(tmp_path, mocker, templar, source, task_vars, expected):
+    module_path = tmp_path / 'sample.py'
+    module_path.write_bytes(source + b'from ansible.module_utils.basic import AnsibleModule\n')
+    mocker.patch.object(amc.C, 'DEFAULT_LOCAL_TMP', str(tmp_path))
+    mocker.patch.object(amc, 'recursive_finder')
+
+    data, style, shebang = modify_module('sample', str(module_path), {}, templar, task_vars=task_vars)
+
+    assert style == 'new'
+    assert shebang == expected
+    assert data.startswith(expected.encode() + b'\n' + amc.b_ENCODING_STRING + b'\n')
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('source, task_vars, expected', [
+    (b'#!/usr/bin/ruby -w\nputs 1\n', {}, b'#!/usr/bin/ruby -w'),

+     b'#!/opt/ruby/bin/ruby -w'),
+    (b'#!/usr/bin/ruby  -e "puts 1 + 2"\nputs 1\n', {'ansible_ruby_interpreter': '/opt/ruby/bin/ruby'},
+     b'#!/opt/ruby/bin/ruby  -e "puts 1 + 2"'),
+    (b'print(1)\n', {}, b'#!/usr/bin/python'),
+])
+def test_other_module_shebang(tmp_path, templar, source, task_vars, expected):
+    module_path = tmp_path / 'sample'
+    module_path.write_bytes(source)
+
+    data, style, shebang = modify_module('sample', str(module_path), {}, templar, task_vars=task_vars)
+
+    assert style == 'old'
+    assert shebang == expected.decode()
+    assert data.startswith(expected + b'\n' + amc.b_ENCODING_STRING + b'\n')
